operations.label: Charge the cadmium–ligand mixture

vessel_capacity.qualifier: Nominal flask capacity, not mixture volume.

operations.description: Mix 0.06 g CdO, 3.00 g TOPO, 0.29 g ODPA, 0.08 g HPA and 2 mL ODE. Use the stated 10 mL four-neck flask; liquid charge and vessel capacity remain separate facts.

operations.label: Heat under vacuum

environment.note: Absolute pressure and detailed gas handling are not reported.

operations.description: Heat the charged mixture to 150 °C under vacuum for 1 h. Absolute pressure and stirring are not stated.

operations.label: Dissolve CdO under an inert atmosphere

environment.note: Absolute pressure and detailed gas handling are not reported.

operations.description: Heat to 320 °C under an inert atmosphere until the red-brown mixture becomes clear and colorless. Gas identity and time to endpoint are unreported.

operations.label: Stabilize at the injection temperature

environment.note: Absolute pressure and detailed gas handling are not reported.

operations.description: Increase to 370 °C and wait for temperature stabilization; no waiting duration is specified.

operations.label: Add the separate TOP dose
operations.description: Inject 1.5 mL TOP after the temperature stabilizes at 370 °C. Wait for the injection temperature to recover before precursor addition.

operations.label: Prepare the seed dispersion
operations.description: Prepare a dispersion of 10⁻⁸ mol CdSe seeds in 200 µL TOP. This is a particle amount, not a CdSe formula-unit mass.

operations.label: Prepare sulfur in TOP
operations.description: Prepare a solution of 120 mg sulfur in 1.3 mL TOP; dissolution temperature and duration are not reported.

operations.label: Mix the seed and sulfur feeds
operations.description: Mix the CdSe seed dispersion and sulfur solution in the glove box. The source does not specify glove-box gas identity.

operations.label: Inject the precursor feed
operations.description: Quickly inject the mixed seed/sulfur feed into the flask once the temperature returns to 370 °C. Injection duration is unreported.

operations.label: Quench growth to 80 °C

cooling_rate.qualifier: Approximate magnitude of cooling rate; no exact time inferred.

operations.description: Cool the reaction mixture to 80 °C at approximately 20 °C/min. The shell recipe explicitly refers to the preceding temperature-cycling procedure.

operations.label: Reheat to 370 °C

heating_rate.qualifier: Approximate heating rate; no exact elapsed duration inferred.

operations.description: Reheat to 370 °C at approximately 10 °C/min. The shell procedure says as described above, but does not independently restate the final annealing dwell.

operations.label: Begin cooling for workup
operations.description: Cool after growth; at 60 °C add the anti-solidification toluene before continuing to room temperature. No numerical room temperature or cooling rate is reported.

operations.label: Add toluene during cooling
operations.description: Add 2–3 mL toluene at 60 °C to prevent solidification of the ligands. Shell purification is stated to follow the core treatment.

operations.label: Continue cooling to room temperature
operations.description: Cool to room temperature; no exact temperature or duration supplied.

operations.label: Remove excess ligands with methanol
operations.description: Use multiple cycles of methanol extraction. The exact cycle count and solvent dose are not stated.

operations.label: Separate the nanocrystals
operations.description: Centrifuge after extraction; speed, force and duration are unreported.

operations.label: Dry under nitrogen

environment.note: Absolute pressure and detailed gas handling are not reported.

operations.description: Dry under N2; temperature, pressure, flow and duration are unreported.

operations.label: Redisperse and store in toluene
operations.description: Redisperse and store in toluene. Solvent volume, concentration, storage temperature and duration are not reported.

quality.review_scope: Independent root R2 scientific audit of all four supplied main pages, four figures, equation 1 and the 42-reference bibliography passed. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete four-page supplied main; local filename search found only identical main copies. SI and cited full methods unreviewed.
Inert gas identity, absolute pressure, stirring and many transfer/workup times are not reported. Nitrogen is named only for drying.
The CdSe flask capacity is not stated; the 10 mL four-neck vessel is explicitly a CdSe/CdS shell-growth apparatus.
No final solution concentration, chemical yield, physical batch identifier or atom-resolved interface/coordinates is supplied.
TEM ± values are retained without assigning a standard-deviation/standard-error interpretation. At least 100 particles were analyzed.
The source gives no variant-specific structure for the omitted-extra-TOP large-seed recipe; displayed core data are not duplicated onto it.
Independent source audit passed; presentation remains pending.
conflicts: Figure 4 labels the temperature cycle 80–370–80 °C; methods describe cooling from injection to 80 °C, reheating to 370 °C and then room-temperature workup. Preserve the schematic without imposing a final 80 °C hold.
Figure 4 labels growth <001>, whereas the text discusses <002>. Both source labels are retained as author interpretation without a crystallographic correction.
